Reconcile only supported facts, label unresolved conflicts, create one final handoff with the current state, verified facts, next action, and uncertainties, and leave source records unchanged.
user_prompt: Please prepare the handoff for the Oakridge reimbursement case. The workspace has the material.

# Case handoff convention

Create exactly one final handoff at `outgoing/oakridge-reconciliation-handoff.md`. It must have these four headings: `## Current state`, `## Verified facts`, `## Next action`, and `## Uncertainties`. Do not edit source records.
